exact_title: VASCULAR COMPLICATIONS IN PEDIATRIC PANCREATITIS: A CASE SERIES

tables.title: Clinical Characteristics and Risk Factors of Children with Peripancreatic Vascular Complications
Treatment and Outcomes of Children with Peripancreatic Vascular Complications

coverage_decision: All 10 supplied PDF pages were rendered and inspected. Both main-text tables are reconstructed. No main-text figures or algorithms are present. The referenced supplement was not supplied and is therefore not appraised.
omissions: Referenced supplementary material/Table S1 was not present in the retrieved Google Drive folder.
source_integrity_findings: The abstract reports 5/410 (1.2%) peripancreatic vascular complications, comprising 4 venous thromboses and 1 left gastric artery pseudoaneurysm. The What is New box calls 1.2% the incidence of PSMVT; strictly, 4/410 venous thromboses is approximately 1.0%, so the source uses vascular-complication and PSMVT terminology inconsistently.

The abstract states that among 2 venous-thrombosis patients who did not receive anticoagulants, 1 recanalized. The Results text instead says 1 of the other 3 non-anticoagulated patients recanalized, apparently including the pseudoaneurysm patient; Table 2 labels that patient as did not re-canalize despite treatment by arterial coiling. These source-specific semantics are preserved rather than silently harmonized.
